contract.callback_failure_isolation: An exception raised by one listener does not abort delivery to subsequent listeners
contract.emit_success: EventBus emit remains successful when an individual listener raises an exception
contract.delivery_order: Listeners continue to receive the event in deterministic registration order
contract.registry_stability: A listener exception does not mutate or corrupt the listener registry
contract.payload_integrity: The source payload remains unchanged after callback execution and exception handling
contract.error_containment: Listener callback failures are contained by EventBus and do not escape the emit delivery loop
